Anya Sales: Quick handover for Sunnyvale (mid-market, annual committed spend ~$45k). Signed last week; pilot starts Mon 2024-12-09. Primary asks: SAML SSO, VPC peering to us-east-1, and a Dedicated pool for inference (peak 80 rps, 1.5k tokens/req). Renewal window 11 months; flagged as medium renewal-risk if onboarding slips.
Marco CSM: Thanks Anya — I'll own the onboarding playbook and customer-facing comms. @Lee CS-Eng will lead infra/telemetry tickets.
Lee CS-Eng: Got it — creating eng ticket now. Need sample prompts, expected seq lengths distribution, and whether they plan to enable prefix caching.
Anya Sales: Sharing sample prompts below and a short example payload. They expect ~60% chat-style prompts, 40% single-turn.
Anya Sales: ```json
{
  "prompt_type": "chat",
  "avg_input_tokens": 350,
  "avg_output_tokens": 1200
}
```
Tori SE: I'll prep a Dedicated sizing note and quantization recommendation. Quick Q: will they accept 8-bit quant models?
Anya Sales: They prefer fidelity over max compression; OK with 4/8-bit only if we validate on their eval set.
Marco CSM: Action items: (1) Lee — eng ticket with labels: customer:Sunnyvale, priority:high, area:dedicated-vpc; (2) Tori — sizing doc + test plan; (3) Sara — support runbook + SLA questions. I'll schedule a 30m kickoff for Tue.
Lee CS-Eng: Ticket created: INC-10452. Assigning to eng-infra oncall. Added attachments: sample prompts, contract excerpt. Noted expected peak and tokens.
Sara Support: Heads-up — add contact matrix and escalation path. Who is primary POC for credentials and networking? Also need expected error/latency SLAs they care about.
Anya Sales: POC is "Jamal - Sunnyvale Eng Lead" (jamal@sunnyvale.co). They want 99th pct latency < 700ms for single-token-prefix runs; multi-turn can be 1.2s.
Lee CS-Eng: Noted latency SLOs. Will validate baseline on our staging with same model family. If we can't hit 99p<700ms on Dedicated, we'll propose fallback routing to hosted low-latency tier.
Tori SE: Preparing perf test harness. Will need access to their repo for prompt/formatting edge cases — can @Anya or Jamal share a small dataset?
Anya Sales: I'll get a sanitized sample set today.
Marco CSM: Renewal risk note: if pilot doesn't launch within 21 days we'll flag for executive intervention. I'll track in account health board and send weekly status.
Sara Support: I'll draft the support runbook and include playbook steps for SSO failures, VPC peering issues, and model-regression alerts. Will share early for feedback.
Lee CS-Eng: Also adding observability hooks: token-level cost, per-route p99 latency, and response regression alerts tied to eval prompts. Need ownership for alert runbooks.
Tori SE: I'll own initial eval runs and share a short validation checklist: correctness on seed prompts, latency matrix across seq lengths, and memory/kv cache benchmarks.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: infra-provisioning for Sunnyvale Dedicated pool on 2024-12-07T18:00:00Z (ETA: 2h).
Marco CSM: Next steps summary: Anya to share dataset + Jamal contact (today). Lee to post eng ticket updates (EOD). Tori to deliver sizing doc + test plan (tomorrow). Sara to post draft runbook (48h). I'll run weekly sync and update account health card.
Anya Sales: Thanks team — cc @Jamal once dataset is ready.
Lee CS-Eng: Quick note — tagging this with escalation:strategy=canary-rollout if capacity uncertain.
Sara Support: Ping me in thread when runbook draft is up; I'll add known issues template and support rotation.
Marco CSM: Captured. Closing the handover thread here; will reopen if blockers. :thumbsup:
